# dsh-composer-launcher
**One "+" panel for compositions, plugins and MCP.**
> ⚠️ **DSH 1.5 only** (`>=0.1.5-rc.2 <0.2.0`). Newer DSH releases will be supported in follow-up upd
**DSH 1.5 only** (`>=0.1.5-rc.2 <0.2.0`). Newer DSH releases will be supported in follow-up updates.
> 🟢 **Collision risk: very low.** This is a **pure UI plugin with no server-side seam at all** — it
never rewrites requests, tool results or the system prompt, so the "functional collision" layer does

**English** · 简体中文
**The composer's `+` button, turned into a real menu.**
## What this is
By default the `+` button left of the composer opens a file picker. Everything else you may want to
point the model at — a browser tab you are looking at, an earlier conversation, a skill, an MCP serv
er, one of the plugins installed on this machine — has to be typed by hand, or referenced with `@`.
`dsh-composer-launcher` replaces that button with a **three-group menu**:
| Group | What is in it |

| **Add** | files and folders, earlier chats, plan mode, goal mode |
| **Capabilities** | slash comm

ands, skills, MCP servers |
| **Common plugins** | one row per installed plugin, plus an "all plugin

ills, MCP servers |
| **Common plugins** | one row per installed plugin, plus an "all plugins" row |
What you pick does not get pasted in as text. It becomes a **reference chip** on a rail above the in
put box — the same native chip kind the host already renders for `@` references — and only turns int
o message text when you actually send.
There is also an **optional browser extension** (`DSH Tab Bridge`) which pushes your real browser's
tabs to the plugin over a loopback HTTP bridge, so the Tabs row lists the pages you genuinely have o
pen rather than a throwaway debug instance.
## What it does
### 1. The `+` menu (three groups)
A 360px panel, opened from the button at the `conversation.input.left` slot.
[该节后续省略]
### How it works
It does not poll. The extension **pushes**:
| Trigger | Action |
| `tabs.onCreated` / `onUpdated` / `onRemoved` / `onActivated` / `onMoved` / `onAttached` / `onDetac

hed` | push immediately |
| a 1-minute `alarms` heartbeat | push |
| browser startup, install, updat

h immediately |
| a 1-minute `alarms` heartbeat | push |
| browser startup, install, update | push |
Each push is a `POST` to `http://127.0.0.1:43130/composer-launcher/tabs` with `{ tabs: [...] }`. A f
ailed push is swallowed, never thrown — the bridge is allowed to be down, and the extension must not
spam console errors while it is.
The host keeps the last push for **65 seconds** (`PUSH_TTL_MS`), deliberately longer than the 1-minu
te heartbeat, so one slow tick cannot make the row flicker to empty. An **empty** push is ignored ra
ther than obeyed (`ignored: 'empty-push-kept-previous'`), because a browser that momentarily reports
nothing must not wipe the list.
Pushed fields are `{ id, title, url, host, favIconUrl, browser }`. Internal pages are filtered befor
e sending: `chrome:`, `edge:`, `brave:`, `opera:`, `vivaldi:`, `about:`, `devtools:`, `chrome-extens
ion:`, `extension:`, `moz-extension:`.
The popup shows the connection state, lets you edit the port, and has a **Save and push now** button
for when you do not want to wait for the next heartbeat.
### With `dsh-capability-composer` — a real, two-way link
This is the one integration that changes what you see, so it is worth being precise about it.
**What the launcher does.** It declares one linked plugin:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
At startup it probes that path and logs `connected` or `absent` per plugin. In the client half it th
en uses the composer's own endpoints:
| Uses | Endpoint | If the composer is missing |
| The plugin rows' narrowing scope | `/dsh-capability-composer/effective?sessionId=…` | Falls back t

o listing **all** plugins and shows why |
| The settings-jump buttons | `/dsh-capability-composer/st
ate` | Buttons do not jump; a dismissible banner names the missing plugin |
**What happens when the composer is absent.** Nothing breaks. The Common plugins group lists every i
nstalled plugin instead of the narrowed set, and the two **Set composition**（「设置组合」）buttons refuse t
o jump — clicking one shows, for 15 seconds:
> dsh-capability-composer is not installed — install and enable it, then come back and hit Set compo
apability-composer is not installed — install and enable it, then come back and hit Set composition.
[该节后续省略]
## Known limitations (stated plainly)
- **The enable/disable switch is not wired.** Plugin rows show state and link to settings; they do n

ot toggle a plugin on or off.
- **Real tabs need the extension** (or the debug browser). There is no

third path — a plugin cannot reach into a browser it is not running inside.
- **The bridge port is
`43130` unless `DSH_LAUNCHER_BRIDGE_PORT` overrides it.** The extension's side is editable in its po

pup.
- **Chromium will not let this plugin install the extension into the browser you already use.**
It can start its own browser with the extension attached, and it can point precisely at the manual
steps; installing silently into an existing browser requires an enterprise policy and administrator

rights, which this repository does not ship.
- **Firefox's MV3 support means a temporary load** in m

ost builds; that is a browser constraint, not a plugin one.
- **The favicon proxy accepts arbitrary
URLs.** It is sandboxed, byte-sniffed and size-limited, but it is still the one route worth understa
nding before you expose a machine.
